root_cause: A bounded sample of 24 completed runs contained only 15 valid executed jobs, below the unchanged 20-job and five-attempt advisory policy.
fix: Broaden observed completed-run window from 24 to 48, list 80 records, stop on sufficient independently validated evidence and fail closed on provider errors.
prevention_rule: Never lower job coverage thresholds or infer successes from missing timestamps; all changes remain advisory without mutation.
